long_portrait.title: Portrait of Crawford Williamson Long. Wellcome M0003193.jpg
long_portrait.caption: Crawford Long, the Georgia country doctor who operated under ether in 1842
long_portrait.desc: Head-and-shoulders portrait of Long (bearded) inside an oval on a plain pale mount; about 40% of the frame is blank margin. Face centre, slightly right, about a third of the way down (upper third). Face position from automatic face detection on a thumbnail.

long_1877.title: Crawford Long, 1877.jpg
long_1877.credit: From Joseph Jacobs's 1919 recollections of Long / Wikimedia Commons
long_1877.caption: Crawford Long in 1877, about a year before his death
long_1877.desc: Small photograph (569 x 711), portrait filling the frame with no border. Face detected centre-right near the top (upper fifth); detail heaviest in the middle band. Low resolution: keep push-ins gentle.

long_statue.title: CW Long Statue.jpg
long_statue.caption: Crawford Long's marble statue in the U.S. Capitol, part of the National Statuary Hall Collection (modern photograph)
long_statue.desc: Vertical modern photo of the standing white-marble statue by J. Massey Rhind (Commons files it under the Capitol Crypt). No border, detail spread evenly; statue presumed centred. No face detected, so the head position (upper third, centre) is a guess.

long_statue_unveiling.title: Unveiling of Statue of Crawford W. Long in Statuary Hall, Washington, D. C.png
long_statue_unveiling.caption: The unveiling of Crawford Long's statue in Statuary Hall, Washington, D.C.
long_statue_unveiling.desc: Black-and-white landscape group photograph, no border; detail fairly even across the frame. Statue and crowd positions are a guess (statue probably centre).

long_honored_1927.title: Honor memory of sleep producer. Doctors attending the American Medical meeting in Washington D.C., honor memory of Crawford (...) of Georgia, discoverer of the use of sulphuric ether LCCN2016888383.jpg
long_honored_1927.credit: Harris & Ewing / Library of Congress / Wikimedia Commons
long_honored_1927.caption: Doctors at the 1927 American Medical Association meeting in Washington honour Crawford Long, with his daughter Frances Long Taylor
long_honored_1927.desc: Vertical black-and-white glass-negative photo of a group of people; strongest detail in the middle band, slim dark edges. No faces detected at thumbnail size, so the group's position (centre, middle third) is a guess.

long_museum.title: Crawford W. Long Museum.jpg
long_museum.caption: The Crawford W. Long Museum in Jefferson, Georgia (2024)
long_museum.desc: Modern exterior photo, no border. Detail heaviest across the middle and lower bands, so the building likely spans the centre; quieter sky at top left. Framing from a thumbnail edge map.

long_stamp.title: Dr Crawford W Long 1940 Issue-2c.jpg
long_stamp.caption: The 1940 U.S. 2-cent stamp honouring Dr. Crawford W. Long
long_stamp.desc: Small scan (631 x 692) of a single stamp with its white perforated edge; engraved portrait sits centre. Low resolution: use small or with a gentle push-in.

morton_photo.title: Photograph of W. T. G. Morton.jpg
morton_photo.credit: Bushby & Hart, Lynn, Mass. / Wikimedia Commons
morton_photo.caption: William T. G. Morton, who gave the 1846 public ether demonstration in Boston (photograph, about 1865)
morton_photo.desc: Vertical studio photograph, no border. Face centred horizontally, about 40% down from the top. Face position from face detection on a thumbnail.

morton_inhaler.title: Ether inhaler, c. 1846, developed by William T. G. Morton - National Museum of American History - DSC06167.JPG
morton_inhaler.caption: Ether inhaler, about 1846, developed by William Morton (National Museum of American History)
morton_inhaler.desc: Vertical museum photo of the glass inhaler; dark band across the very top (about 8%). Object near centre with detail strongest top-left; exact outline is a guess.

ether_dome_exterior.title: MGH Ether Dome Outside 29Jan2008.jpg
ether_dome_exterior.caption: The Ether Dome on top of the Bulfinch Building at Massachusetts General Hospital, Boston (modern photograph)
ether_dome_exterior.desc: Landscape exterior. Dome and building fill the upper and middle bands (strongest detail there), lower third quieter. Dome likely centre, upper third; a guess from the edge map.

ether_dome_seats.title: MGH Ether Dome Theater 29Jan2008.jpg
ether_dome_seats.caption: The tiered seats of the Ether Dome, the old operating theatre at Massachusetts General Hospital (modern photograph)
ether_dome_seats.desc: Vertical photo of the empty curved benches rising toward the back; detail fills the frame, densest in the middle band. Commons describes it as the seating only (no people, no operation). Exact composition is a guess.

mgh_1846.title: Massachusetts General Hospital, Boston, in 1846-7. Wellcome L0011727.jpg
mgh_1846.caption: Massachusetts General Hospital, Boston, as it looked in 1846-47 (engraving)
mgh_1846.desc: Engraving printed on a pale page; about 40% of the frame is plain margin and the picture sits in the centre band (roughly 4-95% across, 13-95% down). Domed building most likely centre; a guess from the edge map.

boston_1841.title: Boston-view-1841-Havell.jpeg
boston_1841.credit: Robert Havell / Library of Congress / Wikimedia Commons
boston_1841.caption: View of Boston from Dorchester Heights, 1841 (aquatint by Robert Havell)
boston_1841.desc: Wide coloured aquatint, no border. Sky in the top third; city skyline and harbour with ships across the middle, Bunker Hill Monument in the middle background (per the LOC description); foreground below. Detail centred slightly low.

magendie.title: François Magendie. Lithograph by N. E. Maurin. Wellcome M0011348.jpg
magendie.caption: François Magendie, the French physiologist (lithograph by N. E. Maurin)
magendie.desc: Half-length lithograph on pale paper (about 17% blank, mostly a strip at the right edge). Face centred, about 30% down (upper third). Face position from face detection on a thumbnail.

hanaoka_portrait.title: HanaokaSeishu.gif
hanaoka_portrait.caption: Hanaoka Seishu, the Japanese surgeon who operated under full general anesthesia in 1804
hanaoka_portrait.desc: Very small (377 x 378) painted portrait; slight band at the top (about 9%). Face detected left of centre, about a quarter of the way down. Too small for full-screen push-ins; use small or on a card.

hanaoka_statue.title: Seishu Hanaoka01n.jpg
hanaoka_statue.caption: Statue of Hanaoka Seishu at Seishu-no-Sato, beside his old home Shunrinken, Kinokawa, Wakayama (modern photograph)
hanaoka_statue.desc: Landscape outdoor photo; open sky at top left, detail concentrated in the centre and lower right. Statue likely centre to centre-right; a guess from the edge map. Identity confirmed by the Japanese Wikipedia caption.

shunrinken.title: Shunrinken01s3872.jpg
shunrinken.caption: Shunrinken, Hanaoka's home and school in Kinokawa, Wakayama: main house (left) and south row house (right) (modern photograph)
shunrinken.desc: Landscape photo; bright sky in the upper band (about 20% near-white), buildings along the lower half: main house left, south row house right (per the Japanese Wikipedia caption).

datura_illustration.title: Datura metel Blanco1.35.jpg
datura_illustration.credit: Francisco Manuel Blanco, Flora de Filipinas (1880-83) / Wikimedia Commons
datura_illustration.caption: Datura metel, a key herb in Hanaoka's mafutsusan (botanical plate, Flora de Filipinas)
datura_illustration.desc: Botanical plate on white paper (about three-quarters blank); the plant drawing sits centre to slightly right (content roughly 12-97% across). Flower position is a guess.

datura_photo.title: Datura metel (Bengali name- ধুতুরা ফুল); Datura flower.jpg
datura_photo.caption: Datura metel in flower (modern photograph)
datura_photo.desc: Landscape photo on a very dark background; the flower sits in the centre (strongest detail in the middle row); thin dark band at the top.

winder_downtown.title: Downtown Winder at Night.jpg
winder_downtown.caption: Downtown Winder, Georgia, where Doctors' Day began in 1933 (modern photograph)
winder_downtown.desc: Night street scene, landscape, no border. Lit buildings across the middle band, darker sky above and street below; centre of interest middle. A guess from the edge map.
